phase: V6 Phase 10 - controlled real-world validation proposal

project_policy.lab_creation: Copy Assets, ProjectSettings and Packages only. Never copy or modify the source Library.
project_policy.why_copy_instead_of_modify: The task requires the existing Unity 6000.6.2f1 project as the engine baseline but also forbids modifying the Phase 5 project. A disposable copy satisfies both requirements and keeps the Phase 5 evidence hash-stable.
project_policy.source_integrity_check: Before and after every lab stage, recompute the 38 protected hash entries and confirm git status is unchanged for all protected paths.

existing_import_state.summary: Unity already imported the Phase 3 and Phase 4 FBX files during the Phase 5 scene build. That is intermediate engine evidence, but it was never independently audited for mesh counts, bone mapping, clip playback, texture colour space or material appearance.

lab_stages.name: Create lab
actions: robocopy Assets, ProjectSettings and Packages from validation/unity-jungle-v6 to validation/v6-phase10/unity-import-lab
open once in batch mode with -nographics to regenerate Library
record source-tree hash before and after

lab_stages.name: Import character
actions: copy the Phase 10 character FBX and textures into Assets/P10/Character
set animationType Generic, importAnimation true, import normals, no cameras or lights
set base color sRGB true; normal and roughness sRGB false
reimport and record AssetDatabase results

lab_stages.name: Validate character appearance
actions: instantiate the imported prefab in a neutral scene
bind the 7 materials
capture front, side and three-quarter views at 1280x720
sample center pixels and assert the render is not uniform magenta
pass: Fur base color and normal maps non-null

lab_stages.name: Validate animation playback
actions: play each clip for at least 0.3 seconds of scaled time
sample hand, foot, head and tail bone world positions at t=0, t=0.25 and t=0.5 of clip length
record maximum displacement and finite checks
capture one frame per clip
pass: Clip length matches the source within 5%

lab_stages.name: Import environment
actions: copy the Phase 10 environment FBX and textures into Assets/P10/Environment
import with the same model-importer discipline
record triangle count, renderer count, terrain bounds and material slots

lab_stages.name: Integrate scene and gameplay
actions: build the scene from imported assets using the existing builder logic
add CharacterController player, camera, HUD, collectibles, checkpoints, destination and river hazard
run the existing acceptance checks

lab_stages.name: Run Unity tests
actions: run EditMode and PlayMode suites in batch mode
parse XML results

lab_stages.name: Build and run
actions: build StandaloneWindows64 into validation/v6-phase10/builds/windows
run the auto-play harness for at least one completion
capture four screenshots and performance

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Unity imports JungleMonkey.fbx with zero errors and the console contains no 'Failed to import' or missing-script message.
objective_acceptance_tests.method: Batch-mode editor log plus editor validation report.

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Imported character triangle count matches the Blender source within tolerance.
The character imports as a skinned mesh with the full skeleton.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: bones = 23; every vertex has at least one non-zero weight

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Four named clips exist with non-zero length.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: Idle, Walk, Run, Jump present; length > 0.1 s each

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Each locomotion clip moves bones over time.
objective_acceptance_tests.method: Animator.Play + sample bone transforms at three normalized times.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: max displacement > 0.01 m for Idle/Walk/Run; > 0.05 m for Jump

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Base color is sRGB and normal/roughness are linear.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: base color true; normal false with textureType NormalMap; roughness false

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Every renderer has a non-null material with a non-null shader and no error shader.
Rendered character is not the magenta error colour.
objective_acceptance_tests.method: Capture 1280x720 PNG and sample pixels; compare with the expected palette.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: No dominant full-frame magenta; human review accepts the capture

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: Imported terrain is non-flat and the river exists.
objective_acceptance_tests.method: Mesh bounds and named object search.
objective_acceptance_tests.threshold: terrain Y range > 5 m; River_Water present

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: The imported assets support the real gameplay loop.
objective_acceptance_tests.method: PlayMode tests for spawn, movement, jump, collection, pause, completion and river game over.

objective_acceptance_tests.assertion: A new Windows player builds from the lab scene.
The built player completes the level.
The source Phase 5 and V5 projects are unchanged.

artifacts: Gameplay frame with player and environment
criteria: Character silhouette and proportions are recognizable
Fur base colour and normal detail are visible
No obvious mesh explosion, inverted normals or missing faces
Environment terrain, vegetation, water and ruins are visible
No magenta or black material failure
No obvious z-fighting or floating props
human_visual_review.not_claimed: Human visual acceptance is not pixel-perfect art approval and does not make the prototype production art.

known_limitations_that_phase10_will_not_: Character and environment are procedural prototypes, not sculpted production art.
Animations are short procedural clips, not authored performances.
AO, emission and opacity maps are absent.
Roughness maps are not wired into the current Unity materials.
Water is visual plus contact hazard; there is no swimming or buoyancy.
Navigation is metadata only; no runtime navmesh.
No automatic provider-to-engine import path exists.
No untrusted third-party asset import is enabled.
